vata.recommendation: Favor warm, freshly cooked, well-seasoned meals with healthy fats (like Ghee or sesame oil). Avoid cold, raw, or dry foods.
vata.rationale: Warm and moist dietary habits help balance cold and dry Vata attributes.

vata.recommendation: Maintain a consistent daily routine (Dinacharya) for meals, sleep, and gentle daily activities.
vata.rationale: Regular schedules stabilize erratic Vata energy.

pitta.recommendation: Favor naturally cooling, sweet, bitter, and astringent foods. Minimize excessively spicy, salty, or sour foods.
pitta.rationale: Cooling foods regulate internal metabolic heat associated with Pitta.

pitta.recommendation: Avoid excessive direct sun exposure and take adequate breaks during intense mental or physical tasks.

kapha.recommendation: Prefer light, warm, dry, and well-spiced foods. Limit heavy, oily, chilled, or excessively sweet foods.
kapha.rationale: Light, warm foods stimulate digestion and reduce Kapha heaviness.

kapha.recommendation: Engage in regular, brisk physical exercise daily.
kapha.rationale: Active movement balances Kapha lethargy and maintains optimal metabolism.

present.recommendation: Ensure adequate rest, hydration, and temporary reduction of heavy physical or mental strain during active symptoms.
present.rationale: Allows the body's natural healing mechanisms to address current health alterations (Vikriti).

strong.recommendation: Maintain balanced nutrition to support naturally strong tissue quality (Dhatu Sara).
strong.rationale: Sustains healthy tissue nourishment and natural immunity.

moderate.recommendation: Include wholesome, nutrient-dense foods (whole grains, fresh produce, legumes) to optimize tissue nourishment.

strong.recommendation: Continue well-proportioned strength training or moderate exercise matching your robust body build.
strong.rationale: Supports naturally well-developed muscular build and structural stability.

balanced.recommendation: Maintain your current proportionate height-weight balance with balanced caloric intake.
balanced.rationale: Proportionate anthropometric measurements correlate with systemic metabolic stability.

well_tolerated.recommendation: Continue eating wholesome, familiar home-cooked meals that suit your digestive habituation.

sometimes_intolerant.recommendation: Identify and temporarily minimize known trigger foods (such as overly spicy or fried foods) that cause mild discomfort.
sometimes_intolerant.rationale: Protects digestive comfort and prevents metabolic irritation.

strong.recommendation: Continue mindfulness practices, structured daily focus, and positive coping strategies.
strong.rationale: Strong Sattva indicates high mental resilience and emotional stability.

moderate.recommendation: Incorporate daily gentle breathing exercises (Pranayama) or short walks to manage mental stress.
moderate.rationale: Supports mental clarity and emotional equilibrium.

strong.recommendation: Maintain regular meal times and eat according to hunger capacity without overeating.
strong.rationale: Strong digestive capacity (Abhyavaharana Shakti) functions best with regular meal schedules.

moderate.recommendation: Eat moderate portions at fixed intervals; avoid eating heavy snacks between main meals.
moderate.rationale: Allows complete digestion of previous meals.

strong.recommendation: Perform 30-45 minutes of moderate physical exercise daily (e.g. brisk walking, cycling, yoga).
strong.rationale: High exercise tolerance allows effective physical conditioning without fatigue.

moderate.recommendation: Engage in 20-30 minutes of mild to moderate physical activity, stopping before onset of exhaustion.
moderate.rationale: Protects energy reserve while maintaining cardiovascular fitness.

adulthood.recommendation: Maintain balanced work-life routines, regular sleep (7-8 hours), and periodic health checkups.
adulthood.rationale: Adulthood (Middle age/Yuva-Madhya Vaya) requires balanced activity to sustain career and physical health.

older_adulthood.recommendation: Prioritize gentle movement (such as walking or light yoga), joint mobility, and easy-to-digest warm meals.
older_adulthood.rationale: Nourishes natural age-related Vata changes in later life stages.
